task_completion.description: Open the Camera Rules dialog for the 'Entrance Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Camera Rules' or 'Event Rules' window is open, with 'Entrance Camera' selected or visible in the context.

task_completion.description: Create a new Soft Trigger named 'Report Incident'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An Event Rule is visible with 'Event' set to 'Soft Trigger' and the 'Name' field set to 'Report Incident'.

task_completion.description: Configure the first action to create a bookmark with a 1-minute duration and 'Manual_Report' tag.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An action is set to 'Create Bookmark'. The 'Fixed Duration' is set to '1:00' (or 60s) and the 'Tags' field contains 'Manual_Report'.

task_completion.description: Configure the second action to start recording for 5 minutes at Best/High quality.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second action is set to 'Camera Recording'. The 'Duration' is set to '5:00' (or 300s) and 'Quality' is set to 'Best' or 'High'.

task_completion.description: Ensure the trigger is visible to all users.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Soft Trigger settings, the 'Available to' or 'Permissions' field is set to 'All Users'.

task_completion.description: Verify the 'Report Incident' button appears on the Entrance Camera overlay.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Entrance Camera' live view is visible with a clickable button labeled 'Report Incident' on the right-hand side or bottom overlay.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target camera is 'Entrance Camera'. The soft trigger must be named 'Report Incident'. The bookmark action requires a duration of 60,000ms (1 min) and the tag 'Manual_Report'. The recording action requires a duration of 300,000ms (5 mins) at Best/High quality.
